question: Does same-session target-state complete-program replay produce terminal Official wins that a second equally strong free-Agent session does not under one shared open operation boundary?
scientific_role: Consumed/Dev falsification cohort for same-session complete-program replay; not protected-set effect estimation.

selection.v5_results_role: pilot only; excluded from v6 causal effect estimation

execution.followup_eligibility: A1 formed an admissible complete program and independent Official completed but failed for a deployment reason
execution.followup: Run both A2 and B for every eligible A1 failure in the preassigned per-case order
execution.pre_candidate_failure: Record as a replay boundary; do not run conditional A2/B
execution.unique_treatment_difference: B may call target-state complete-program replay and receive its result before the same active Agent session ends; A1 and A2 cannot

machine_roles.spark: one remote CUDA-capable construction/replay lane and primary independent Official queue

analysis.primary_contrast: B-exclusive wins versus A2-exclusive wins; both-pass and both-fail are ties
analysis.deployment_validity: Official Pass and outcome-blind v6 executable-source adjudication

decision.promote: Only reproducible B-exclusive deployment-valid Official wins establish incremental terminal success over A2.
decision.retain: Evidence is mixed or opportunity count is insufficient; do not add replay rules.
decision.kill: No reproducible B-exclusive terminal advantage, or A2 matches or exceeds B across the opportunity cohort.

safeguard_policy: No new hash or software gate. Git records implementation and preregistration; ordinary tests check parity and schedule consistency.
